q: 1. The minimum lighting for the library of the school building is .............
explain: School building design standards specify a minimum illumination level of 100 lux for library spaces to support reading and study activities.

q: 2. There should be provision of 1 wash basin per ............. students in school buildings.
explain: School sanitation norms in this reference specify one wash basin should be provided for every 20 students.

q: 3. Minimum plinth level for school building is ............. above the road level.
explain: Building norms for school buildings require the plinth to be raised a minimum of 400 mm above the road level, protecting the structure from surface water and dampness.
